source_contract.next_step: audit computation-versus-returned-gap scaling as the lane Cartesian action family grows; keep this fixed-catalogue result closed

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

rule.base_grid: the complete 10x10x10 threshold-aware Cartesian grid; no sampling or RNG
rule.queue_scaling: multiply every base coordinate by the integer lanes/2; no rounding
rule.primary_coefficient: alpha_R(K)=max over nonempty scaled grid of returned gap/L1(queue)
rule.capacity_bridge: recompute the existing conditional capacity certificate at each synthetic lane count and require eta_R(load)-alpha_R(K)>1e-10
rule.computation: compare paid candidate attempts and fully charged logical work with the analytic ordered family size 10^R; never materialize that family

advance_gate.per_scaled_lane_capacity_margin: there exists a frozen K with eta_R(load)-alpha_R(K)>1e-10 at loads 0.50, 0.80 and 0.95
advance_gate.per_scaled_lane_computation: the same K has candidate and charged logical work fractions below 0.05

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more frozen execution checks fail
decision_rule.MEANINGFUL_LAZY_SCALING_ADVANCE: every synthetic scaled lane count 4, 8 and 16 has one frozen checkpoint passing both capacity-margin and computation gates
decision_rule.COMPUTE_SAVING_WITH_LOOSE_CERTIFICATE_ST: all scaled lane counts save computation but at least one lacks a checkpoint whose returned-gap alpha preserves every load margin
decision_rule.CERTIFICATE_WITHOUT_COMPUTE_SAVING_STOP: all scaled lane counts preserve a load margin but at least one fails the computation gate

protocol.claim_boundary: A deterministic finite-grid computation and returned-certificate result for synthetic independent replicas of the fixed nine-option dual-GPU lane model. It is not evidence for multi-GPU physical throughput, interference, queue stability, flow-time tails, deployment, untested grid points, or all queues.
protocol.prohibited: full Cartesian action enumeration, an oracle, arrivals, trajectories, drains, RNG, server data, confirmation runs, paper edits, and post-outcome changes to the grid, lanes, budgets, or gates

claim_boundary: A deterministic finite-grid computation and returned-certificate result for synthetic independent replicas of the fixed nine-option dual-GPU lane model. It is not evidence for multi-GPU physical throughput, interference, queue stability, flow-time tails, deployment, untested grid points, or all queues.
limitations: The 1,000 deterministic points are a finite grid, not a complete integer box or all-queue proof.
Lane counts above two replicate cached dual-GPU lane options without modelling added interference or topology.
A loose returned gap does not prove the selected action is poor; it means this bounded search did not certify a tighter guarantee.
Analytic raw action counts are computation references, not measured exhaustive runtimes.
next_step: tighten the scalable frontier bound before any trajectory experiment
